### Whose Power?
Author: Jana Kelley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/wholly-loved-jan-29.html
Passage: Numbers 14:41
Points:
- Believers often swing between paralyzing fear and reckless self-reliance when facing difficulties.
- After refusing to enter the land out of fear, the Israelites presumptuously attacked in their own strength.
- Moses warned the people that acting contrary to God's command was doomed to fail.
- Depending on personal skill rather than God's guidance leads directly to defeat.
- True victory comes from continually trusting and moving in the Lord's power.

### Bible Pathways - Feb. 19, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-19-2009-11599753.html
Passage: Numbers 14:40-43
Points:
- The Israelites admitted their sin verbally but failed to show genuine repentance.
- After rejecting God's command through unbelief, they sinned again through presumptuous pride.
- Moses warned them that advancing into battle without the Lord's presence would guarantee defeat.
- Relying on independent human reasoning inevitably fails when moving against God's will.
- Spiritual prosperity requires yielding our own understanding and faithfully obeying God's Word.
